details.name: Java Plugin
details.who: All Firefox users who have installed the Java plugin, JRE versions below 1.6.0_33 or between 1.7.0 and 1.7.0_4.
details.why: Outdated versions of the Java plugin are vulnerable to an actively exploited security issue. All users are strongly encouraged to update their Java plugin. For more information, please read our blog post or Oracle's Advisory.
